_comment: Image size variants published alongside a record's media URL, per source.
TBIA's export carries ONE URL per image, and for several institutions that
URL is a downscaled derivative — HAST's is 683x1024, too small to read a
handwritten label. The bigger renditions exist on the same bucket under a
different filename suffix; nothing in the export says so, which is why this
file exists. Read by app/media.py, re-read when the file's mtime changes.
A rule matches on `url_prefix` (a literal, matched case-insensitively) and
rewrites the filename's `suffix` -> another size's suffix. `canonical` is
the suffix the export actually ships, so a rule that stops matching leaves
the original URL untouched rather than inventing one.
long_edge is the real pixel long edge, measured, not assumed: it is what
decides whether the Claude vision API downscales the image before reading
it (2576px / 3.75MP on the current models), and therefore whether a bigger
file buys detail or only bandwidth.
Adding a source is an edit here plus nothing else. Verify the sizes exist
before adding them -- a 404 is worse than a small image.

rules.note: 中央研究院生物多樣性研究博物館 (BRMAS) / HAST herbarium sheets, ~126k records. Verified 2026-08-13 against S_138530: every suffix returns 200.
